purpose: Pre-holdout configuration snapshot, prepared after development-only tuning

technicalAmendment.reason: Two incomplete formal runs stopped on malformed AI JSON at cases 28 and 10. Neither produced a final summary. Original snapshot preserved as FROZEN_CONFIG_before_format_retry.json.
technicalAmendment.change: Repeat identical model requests up to three times only when the provider returns invalid JSON. No prompt, retrieval, refusal rule, label, scorer, or model was changed.

development.notes: Early exploratory runs are archived. Only development outputs informed numeric-unit normalization and retrieval design.

algorithm.retrievalScore: bounded lexical count with matched-term coverage and a small development-selected synonym map
algorithm.abstentionRule: no retrieved evidence or missing citation or unsupported numeric claim, with categorical model states
algorithm.baseline: highest-ranked lexical passage with decimal-safe sentence extraction
algorithm.provider: Manus project AI fallback, since the protected school OpenRouter secret was not confirmed

labelCaveat: Every evidence quotation is source-text checked against a real PDF page, but no independent human review of all labels has been claimed.
